'''Oradam village''' was a small settlement on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] located on the [[Oradam Peninsula]].

The village was mostly untouched by the [[Separatist War|civil war]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], despite numerous strikes from the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]]. It was under almost the sole control of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]].

The village contained several residences, a workshop, and a vehicle depot, where mostly agricultural vehicles were kept. Other features of the village include a small medical station, and a speeder pad used to travel to [[Fort Garnik]] and other places around [[Avilatan]].
